name: OpenScaffold
long_description:
OpenScaffold is the first AI Forward-Deployed Engineer.

Every new customer deployment means weeks of discovery, data cleanup, integrations, and custom business logic. OpenScaffold does that work autonomously. It builds a custom scaffold for each deployment from customer discovery, business objectives, and past deployments, and every deployment makes the next one faster.

launches.title: OpenScaffold: Superagent for Deployment Teams
launches.body:
Launch Video: <https://youtu.be/3P5YgiaoBZo>

**Problem:** Over the past 3 years, the number of AI deployments has increased by 4,600%, with demand projected to grow at an even faster pace. Today, deployment teams are struggling to keep up with this demand. Critical customer context is scattered across GitHub, support tickets, and meeting recordings, slowing down every deployment.

**Solution:** OpenScaffold brings this information together into continuously updating models of each customer. When you need to ship a feature, resolve a bug, or get up to speed on an existing customer, OpenScaffold retrieves the relevant customer-specific context. Then, it’s passed to your coding agents and turns what worked into reusable playbooks.

**Background:** Co-Founders Rushil and Param met while working as employees #1 and #3 at Usul (YC S24), one of the fastest-growing defense tech companies in SF. There, they led deployments for some of the largest U.S. government contractors and helped grow the company’s revenue 10x in under a year.

If you’re looking to get customers live faster and make every deployment easier, we’d love to talk! Grab a time here: <https://calendar.app.google/pt8rrJW5s4Y5HFjT8>
